project_type: New multi-service RAG system 'DocMind' inside an existing polyglot monorepo (d:\Project\digital-spirituality). Two services: api-java (Spring Boot 4 orchestrator + chat/RAG) and doc-service-py (FastAPI document parser). Infra via docker-compose with Postgres+pgvector.
build_system: api-java: Maven (same as sibling 'horoscope' project; use mvnw wrapper). doc-service-py: pip + requirements.txt (venv). Root: docker-compose for Postgres + both services.
test_framework: api-java: JUnit 5 via spring-boot-starter-test (mvn test). doc-service-py: pytest (python -m pytest).
build_command: api-java: cd docmind/api-java && ./mvnw -q -DskipTests package  (Windows: mvnw.cmd). doc-service-py: cd docmind/doc-service-py && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt (base deps only for CI; heavy ML deps are optional/lazy).
test_command: api-java: cd docmind/api-java && ./mvnw -q test  (Windows mvnw.cmd test). doc-service-py: cd docmind/doc-service-py && python -m pytest -q
verification_instructions: FEAT-001: run `docker compose -f docmind/docker-compose.yml config` to validate compose syntax (do NOT require Docker daemon up in CI). FEAT-002: create venv, install base requirements, run `python -m pytest -q` and `python -c "import app.main"`; start uvicorn and curl /healthz, /readyz, POST /v1/parse -> 202 with job_id, poll GET /v1/jobs/{id} and /v1/jobs/{id}/result. FEAT-003: `mvnw.cmd -q -DskipTests package` must compile; `mvnw.cmd -q test` must pass. Full-system check (optional, needs Docker): `docker compose up` then curl the ingest+chat flow. ML models are stubbed so neither service needs model downloads to boot.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Python venv and Java target/ are gitignored. No codegen.
environment_constraints: CPU-only, no GPU anywhere. Heavy/uncertain Python deps (docling, paddleocr/paddlepaddle, firecrawl pdf-inspector, sentence-transformers) MUST be lazy-imported behind stubs so the service boots and tests pass without them installed or without model downloads. Java service must use port 8090 (horoscope already uses 8084; do not clash). Do NOT modify anything outside d:\Project\digital-spirituality\docmind. On Windows use mvnw.cmd and `python` (not python3).
contribution_requirements: Match sibling 'horoscope' conventions where sensible: Maven with mvnw wrapper, package root com.example.docmind, layered packages (config/controller/service/dto/exception plus repository/entity/client for this JPA-backed service), Lombok with explicit annotation-processor paths in maven-compiler-plugin, spring-dotenv for local .env, property style `${ENV_VAR:default}`, committed .env.example + gitignored .env, Vietnamese code comments acceptable. DEVIATION FROM horoscope (REQUIRED by task): DocMind uses Spring Boot 4.0.0 (horoscope is 3.3.11) and PostgreSQL+pgvector+Flyway+JPA (horoscope uses Redis, no DB). The steering file mentioning 'Spring Boot 4.0.6' and MySQL does NOT apply to DocMind's datastore — the task mandates PostgreSQL/pgvector. Use Spring Boot 4.0.0 GA (released 2025-11-20, on Maven Central).
key_patterns: horoscope uses application.properties (not yml), server.port, env-var-backed config with defaults. Controllers thin, delegate to @Service with @RequiredArgsConstructor constructor injection, GlobalExceptionHandler @RestControllerAdvice. DTOs separate from entities. For DocMind add: client/ package for the Python-service REST client; interface + stub-impl pattern for LlmClient and EmbeddingClient so Gemini/real models drop in later. Python service: ParserRouter -> EngineAdapter interface -> stub engines returning canonical blocks; Normalizer emits exact canonical schema; in-memory JobStore; structured JSON logging with correlation chain.
